RUSTRAK_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email you sign in with - the admin account is created on first boot

RUSTRAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, used on first boot only - change it later in the dashboard

CREATE_SUPERUSER.description: Creates the admin on first boot - leave as is

SESSION_SECRET_KEY.description: Signs and encrypts login cookies (64+ characters)

PUBLIC_URL.description: Address the DSNs point at - set it to your custom domain after adding one

SSL_PROXY.description: Railway serves HTTPS, so login cookies are marked secure

HOST.description: Listen on IPv6 and IPv4 so other services can report over the private network

PORT.description: Port Railway routes to - leave as is

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so Rustrak can write to the Railway volume
